summary.name: mongoDB.app
summary.one_liner: A macOS app that runs a local MongoDB server by drag-and-drop install into the Applications folder.
use_cases: run a local mongodb server on a mac
add mongodb binaries to the shell path
test applications against a local mongodb instance
summary.what_it_does: The page describes mongoDB.app as a way to get MongoDB running on a Mac: download, drag the app into the Applications folder, and double-click to launch. Its version numbers reflect the bundled MongoDB binaries, with a separate build number for the mongoDB.app release itself. Users who want the MongoDB command-line tools available in their terminal can add the bundled bin directory (inside Contents/Resources/Vendor/mongodb/bin) to their PATH via ~/.bash_profile. The page is brief and does not list detailed features.
notable: Version numbers track the bundled MongoDB binaries
Bundled mongo binaries can be added to PATH
caveats: Mac only; the page names no other platforms
